invariants.text: Book.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Book.author_id must reference an existing Author.id
Author.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Member.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Loan.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Loan.book_id must reference an existing Book.id
Loan.member_id must reference an existing Member.id

A book's available_copies must be non-negative; borrowing a book reduces its available_copies by one, and returning a book increases it by one, with borrowing the final copy setting the count to zero.
A loan is considered overdue if its due_date is earlier than today and its return_date is null.
Returning a loan that is already marked as returned raises an AlreadyReturnedLoanError and does not modify the loan or book inventory.
When a book is borrowed, its available_copies are decremented by one; when returned, the count is incremented by one.
A new loan's due_date is set to 14 calendar days after the loan_date, and this is computed by the LibraryService, not derived from the book's published_year.
The book search query performs case-insensitive substring matching across title, author name, and ISBN, and returns each matching book only once, even if multiple fields match.
The book list command with --author filters results to only books authored by the specified author ID.
The book list command with --available-only returns only books that have at least one available copy; without this flag, all books are returned regardless of copy count.
A member's membership_date defaults to today's date when created, and is_active defaults to True.
Borrowing and returning operations are performed within a single SQLite transaction to ensure data consistency; if any part fails, all changes are rolled back.
